pre_caption_prompt:

Please concisely specify the type of scenery shot (e.g., a landscape or cityscape scenery shot) in a single fluent paragraph.Also explain why there is no main subject, such as the focus being on the environment, atmosphere, or scale rather than a specific object. Just note that briefly in one to three sentences.

Please avoid using phrases like "the first frame" or "the last frame" in your description. Instead, refer to the entire sequence simply as "the video." Whenever you mention a subject, be sure to include detailed descriptions of its key visual attributes. The final output should be a single, fluent paragraph describing the video, with no Markdown formatting or introductory text. Don't mention the surroundings or the subject's motion unless necessary to distinguish subjects by location, action, or relationship.
pre_caption: This is a landscape scenery shot of a vast, snow-covered mountain range under a dark, starry night sky. A large, futuristic, cloud-shaped building with rows of glowing oval windows sits nestled in the snowy terrain, with a small tracked vehicle parked nearby and tire tracks visible in the foreground. Yellow text reading "Centro de Investigación Cular de IKEA" appears at the bottom of the screen. The video lacks a single main subject, as the wide composition focuses on the expansive, desolate environment and the atmospheric contrast between the cold, natural landscape and the warm light from the man-made structure, emphasizing a sense of scale and isolation.
